summary: Sporting News writer Nick Brinkerhoff gives DFS lineup advice for the Week 15 Monday Night Football game between the Eagles and Seahawks at Lumen Field. He builds a DraftKings Showdown lineup around Captain DK Metcalf and a SuperDraft lineup that goes all-in on both passing attacks. The Seahawks (6-7) are fighting for playoff position, while the Eagles have lost two straight in blowouts and fell behind the Cowboys in the NFC East.
one_line: Sporting News offers DraftKings Showdown and SuperDraft DFS lineups for Eagles-Seahawks Monday Night Football in Week 15, captained by DK Metcalf.
key_facts: The Seahawks are 6-7 and on the outside of the playoff picture entering Monday night against the Eagles.
The Eagles have lost two straight games, both in blowout fashion, and the Cowboys have taken over the NFC East lead.
DraftKings Showdown scoring is full-point PPR with three-point bonuses for 300 passing yards, 100 rushing yards and 100 receiving yards; the Captain costs 1.5x salary and scores 1.5x points.
The DraftKings lineup has a $50,000 budget and requires at least one player from each team.
Captain pick DK Metcalf ($14,400) has four touchdowns in his last two games, including three against the Cowboys, but was ejected against the 49ers last week.
Eagles CB Darius Slay (knee) is absent, worsening an already generous Eagles secondary.
Geno Smith ($9,400) is the QB pick, with Drew Lock ($9,200) as the replacement if Smith does not play.
DeVonta Smith ($9,000) has 62.5 fantasy points over the last three weeks versus 54.5 for A.J. Brown.
Seattle's secondary allowed both Brandon Aiyuk and Deebo Samuel to top 100 yards against San Francisco last week.
D'Andre Swift ($8,000) is expected to get more run usage, as Jalen Hurts is dealing with an illness and Swift has had no impact in three weeks.
Dallas Goedert ($6,200) returned against the Cowboys, catching all four targets for 30 yards, and faces a defense shredded by TEs in back-to-back weeks.
Noah Fant ($2,600) is a sleeper TE pick, projected for about four targets.
SuperDraft scoring is half-point PPR with four-point passing TDs and two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards and 300 passing yards.
The SuperDraft lineup uses Metcalf as Champion (1.8x) with Geno Smith (1.2x), Jalen Hurts (1x), A.J. Brown (1.05x) and DeVonta Smith (1.25x) as Super FLEX.
